We had many people in our comments who assumed we were just random people who bought a tiger cub and many people asking where they can get a tiger. We want to address this because it’s very important. Rick is not just a normal person with a tiger. Rick owns a USDA licensed zoo and Mowgli is not a personal pet. Mowgli came from another zoo and was not purchased as a pet. The reason Mowgli is inside the house (which is on the zoo property) is because he is not fully vaccinated and we will not allow him outside until our vet clears us for that. Anyone who is wanting a pet tiger needs to know that you cannot legally own one as a pet. Also, this is not Rick’s first Tiger. You can go and see Kai, our female, on our page. Rick has extensive experience with big cats and raising them. You can however enjoy how cute he is on our social media! We will NEVER have tiger encounters available and no visitors will ever be allowed to touch him or interact with him. When he is older and cleared to go outside you can see him in his enclosure if you visit the zoo. We hope that clears a few things up!

The golden tabby tiger, also known as the golden tiger, is an exceptionally rare color variation of the Bengal tiger. Its stunning coat is pale gold with faint orange stripes, caused by a recessive genetic mutation called chinchilla albinistic. These tigers are incredibly rare, with only about 30 known to exist, and they are found exclusively in captivity. Breeding programs in zoos and wildlife parks occasionally produce golden tabby tigers, but they are not seen in the wild due to their unique coloration, which reduces their camouflage and makes survival difficult. LE DERNIER DIEU SAUVAGE, c’est le titre de mon dernier documentaire (lien dans ma bio). Comment protéger un animal qui, parfois, tue ceux qui vivent à ses côtés ? C’est la question qui m’a conduit dans les deux régions d’Inde où le tigre provoque le plus d’accidents. Au nord du pays, et dans les mangroves de Sundarbans à la frontière avec le Bangladesh 🇮🇳 🇧🇩  Je suis parti sur ses traces pour comprendre ce paradoxe. Comment concilier leur sécurité avec la conservation de l’espèce ? Et s’il fallait chercher du côté de la spiritualité... J’espère que cette enquête au pays des tigres du Bengale nourrira la réflexion sur l’un des enjeux majeurs de la conservation des espèces menacées: la cohabitation entre les populations rurales et le monde sauvage. #animaux #nature #tigre #documentaire #safari
